paper.title: Accelerating Neuron Reconstruction with PATHFINDER
paper.source_file_status: Original PDF not retrieved; values transcribed from author text mirror, not a byte-pinned PDF

dataset.name: IBEAM-mSEM mouse cortex, paper evaluation cuboid
dataset.evaluation_population: all unmyelinated axons in the evaluation volume
dataset.status: paper description fixed; actual data, ROI origin and memberships not acquired

evaluation.nerl_definition: ERL divided by maximum possible ERL for the same ground truth

implementation_identity: independent paper reconstruction; not author code

ffn_segmentation.agglomeration_acceptance: All three checkpoint-specific gates must pass for a candidate pair
ffn_segmentation.single_checkpoint_gate: ((min(deleted/predicted)<0.02) AND IoU>0.8 AND min(consistency)>0.8) OR (IoU>0.9 AND min(consistency)>0.9)
ffn_segmentation.additional_processing: Blood vessel/glia initialization and semantic-class-specific processing
ffn_segmentation.local_complete_comparison: Single checkpoint, ascending seeds, manual gate; not this full paper protocol
ffn_segmentation.glia_filter_scope: Astrocyte/microglia stage; also requires dominant semantic classification. Not a universal neuronal consensus threshold.
ffn_segmentation.neuronal_split_consensus_min_voxels_stat: Not explicitly stated in the inspected FFN segmentation methods text; do not infer it from the glia threshold or software defaults.
ffn_segmentation.semantic_consensus_exemptions: Soma, nucleus and myelinated-axon supervoxels use class-specific held-back states rather than the full six-way neuronal consensus.
ffn_segmentation.local_min_size_scope: Explicit engineering configuration, identical for both downstream methods; zero in existing diagnostic runs is not a confirmed paper parameter.
